_what: Assignment pack for the process specification campaign. Everything you need about YOUR category. The full model.json is 148 KB and you do not need it; if you want a process id outside this category, ask.
_binding: _Collab/00_prompts/SPEC_CAMPAIGN_PROMPT.md is the binding instruction. _Collab/SOURCE_AUTHORITY_PACK.md is the only permitted source list. Read both in full before writing anything.

bands.Work Lifecycle: 1.0-5.0. Runs in sequence for a single piece of work.
bands.Specialised Operations: 6.0-11.0. Each runs the full lifecycle inside its own operational discipline.
bands.Foundations and Enabling: 12.0-16.0. Supplies assets, materials, workforce, information and external delivery capacity to every lifecycle stage rather than sitting inside the sequence.
bands.Asset Lifecycle: 17.0-19.0. The asset's own life - planned, created, operated and retired - as distinct from the work performed on it. Appended 2026-08-29 without renumbering anything: categories 1.0 to 16.0 keep their ids, uids and legacy_ids.

lifecycle_axis._why: The model is organised on a WORK axis - identify, plan, schedule, execute, close. APQC and GFMAM are organised on an ASSET axis - plan and acquire, design and construct, operate, maintain, dispose. The work axis is what happens inside 'maintain'. Both are valid; carrying both lets the model answer ISO 55001:2024 cl. 8.1 without abandoning the granularity that makes it a process model rather than a benchmarking taxonomy.
lifecycle_axis._all: 'all' marks an enabling category that serves every stage rather than sitting at one of them.

your_category.name: Close Work, Settle Cost and Update Records

processes.name: Return work for rework where deficient
Settle cost to work order and project
Post to fixed asset and property record

groups.name: Produce digital as-built and update asset records

processes.name: Capture field redline against the issued design
Record installed, removed and abandoned units
Review, approve and accept the as-built
Publish as-built change to the network model

your_category.summary: Complete the work record, settle the cost and update the asset and financial position.

apqc_rows_touching_your_category.note: Manage asset construction: 19226 quality control is 5.1, 19227 create work and asset records is 5.4, 19228 site safety and access is 4.4. 19225 Monitor work performance in flight has no group - the model measures after closure (15.1) but does not manage in-flight.
Operations performance management. 19273 Plan and manage control room operations has no group.

gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.name: Asset Costing and Valuation
gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.note: The model settles cost to the work order and unitises it to the property record. It does not value the asset base.

gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.name: Asset Management Assurance and Audit
gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.note: Audit exists per programme - vegetation, DIMP, reporting obligations - but there is no assurance process over the asset management system itself.

gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.name: Knowledge Management
gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.note: Job plan and task libraries, and the document set at the place of work.

gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.name: Asset Management Data & Information Strategy
gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.note: System of record by asset class, and data quality and master data.

gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.name: Configuration Management
gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.note: Asset specifications and as-built update. No configuration baseline or version control over the asset configuration itself.

gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.name: Maintenance Delivery
gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.note: This is the model's centre of gravity and it is the most complete subject in it.

gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.name: Asset Repurposing or Disposal
gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.note: Closed 2026-08-29. 19.2 decommissions physically, 19.3 handles waste and salvage, 19.4 transfers ownership and closes the record. 12.1.6 continues to retire the record and 5.3 the accounting.
